_comment:
Master Mobile Plan (2026) > Update (coverage_matrix.csv XLSX Tab 'Update') > Set up ('Ensure app workspace clean / make new version'). Run via `python scripts/hq_client.py hq_setup/update/setup_make_new_version.json` before flows/update/update_target_developer_options_flow.yaml. app_id is a placeholder - the Update-tab test app gets rebuilt between QA cycles, so confirm it's still current (https://www.commcarehq.org/a/<domain>/apps/view/<app_id>/) before relying on this.

IMPORTANT - documenting a gap rather than fabricating a resolved one: the sheet's own logic here is CONDITIONAL, and today's hq_client.py/run_pre_step() cannot express that branch. The sheet says: click 'Make New Version'; if the app workspace had no pending changes, HQ no-ops (no new build appears) and you're already done - the workspace was already 'clean'. If the workspace DID have pending changes, HQ creates a new build, and that new build then needs to be marked Released (via mark_build_status, see hq_setup/update/install_mark_released.json) before the rest of the Update-tab flow has a real target to update to.

create_new_build() (scripts/hq_client.py, mirroring corehq/apps/app_manager/views/releases.py:save_copy()) always POSTs and returns whatever HQ replies - it does not itself distinguish 'nothing changed' from 'new build created'. per docs/FRAMEWORK.md's own listed gap #2, the exact response shape for that distinction (e.g. whether a genuinely-new saved_app id came back vs the prior latest build's id) hasn't been confirmed against a live HQ response in this environment. run_pre_step()'s action-list schema also has no if/then construct to conditionally chain a mark_build_status call off of create_new_build's result. So this file intentionally performs ONLY the unconditional 'create new version' call below; a human (or a future run_pre_step enhancement that inspects the response and conditionally appends a mark_build_status action) still needs to decide whether hq_setup/update/install_mark_released.json needs to be run afterward. Treat this row as Partial, not Automatable, for exactly that reason.

actions.comment: QA Update-tab workspace check (make new version)
